notes: The template classifies text with Support Triage and, only when priority is high, opens an incident, posts to on-call, and adds a reaction. This program does not choose the priority and does not call Slack.
The Slack message is untrusted. It is sent as JSON data. This program does not follow instructions written inside it and does not post to Slack.
KOVCA_WORKFLOW_ID is not set. --live cannot run until it is the published workflow id.

Use the message ts as the Idempotency-Key. A retry returns the original run instead of opening a second incident, and the duplicate response has no output. Keep the first response. https://kovca.io/docs/idempotency

input.text: Checkout is failing for customers since this morning. They get a 502 after entering card details.
